title: Strawberry Mango Smoothie Bowl
changes_from_base: No açaí: frozen strawberries and mango are pulsed fine, then blended with yoghurt, banana and honey into a thick, spoonable bowl, topped with fresh strawberries, pumpkin seeds and coconut instead of granola.
summary: A thick, fruity smoothie of strawberries and mango topped with crunchy seeds and shredded coconut.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Pulse Fruit
steps.text: Place 140 g frozen strawberries and 140 g frozen mango chunks in a food processor and pulse in 1-second bursts about 20 times until finely chopped.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Scrape down the sides, add 80 g plain yoghurt, ½ ripe banana (broken into pieces), 2 tsp runny honey and a pinch of fine salt and process for about 1 minute until smooth, scraping down halfway.

steps.title: Spoon
steps.text: Carefully remove the blade and spoon the smoothie into 2 serving bowls.

steps.title: Top
steps.text: Top each bowl with 25 g sliced fresh strawberries, ½ tbsp pumpkin seeds and ½ tbsp desiccated coconut.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Eat straight away whilst the texture is at its best.

tips: Use truly frozen fruit to achieve a thick, creamy texture without using ice
Prepare the toppings beforehand so you can serve the smoothie immediately after blending
safety: Keep the processor blade covered with a clean cloth after removing it for safety
storage: Serve straight away. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
